gap: No result ChatGPT got states which hardwire kit each sub-$300 3-channel camera takes and what camera plus kit costs: the Vantrue N4 Pro S ($279.99) passes $300 with any Vantrue kit ($24.99 to $34.99), while the N4S ($199.99) and the VIOFO A229 Pro 3CH ($249.99 on Amazon, plus the $17.99 HK4) stay under.
standout_why: Compared against productbible.com/blog/best-3-channel-dash-cams, the only rival page I could open. It names one hardwire kit (HK6-F, for the over-budget VIOFO T330) with no price, names no kit for the N4 Pro S, N4S or A229 Pro 3CH, and gives no camera-plus-kit total. It already has the Vantrue LTE module at $149.99 and the card limits (1 TB Vantrue, 512 GB A229 Pro), so those are not new. vortexradar.com/best-dashcams returned HTTP 403 and ezdashcam.com/collections/under-300 returned HTTP 429, so I could not check either; that is why this is 2 and not 3. ChatGPT's own answer says a kit is 'separately purchased' and asks whether the $300 includes it, but names no kit and no price.
decides: Camera only: our Vantrue N4 Pro S fits at $279.99. Camera plus parking-mode kit under $300: the N4 Pro S is out ($304.98 with the $24.99 universal kit, $309.98 with the $29.99 kit whose page names it). The Vantrue N4S is in at $224.98 to $234.98, leaving about $65 to $75 for a card, so it deserves a product record (vantrue.com/products/n4s, $199.99, awin:vantrue). The VIOFO A229 Pro 3CH is in at $267.98 only if bought on Amazon at $249.99; viofo.com's catalog search returned no front + rear + cabin A229 Pro or A229 Plus kit, and its A229 Pro 2CH alone is $349.99. The Vantrue LTE module ($149.99) puts any 'optional LTE' build over $300 (N4S $349.98, N4 Pro S $429.98).

findings.label: Kits Vantrue's representative confirms, and the setting the OBD cable needs
findings.value: VP03, VP04 and VP05 all compatible; with the OBD cable, parking-mode entry must be set to G-sensor
findings.source_title: N4 PRO S WONT GO INTO PARKING MODE | DashCamTalk
findings.note: Jeff_Vantrue, 2025-12-03: 'Actually, the VP03, VP04, and VP05 are all compatible with the N4 Pro S.' and 'If you are using the OBD cable, you have to select G-sensor to entry/exit Parking Mode'. The owner (carusos) reported the same day that setting entry to G-sensor plus motion detection fixed it. A forum post by a Vantrue rep, not a maker document.

findings.label: Telephoto add-on takes the rear port
